_about: Hand-written display copy for the recorded day (task #748). Each card restates what was really asked on Nov 3, with brands, links, paths and private names removed by rewriting, never by machine redaction. Option ids, default_option, timing and answers stay as recorded (R166), except decision 9, whose single option 'done,later,question' was three reply words joined by commas and is split here. Applied in place by tools/recorded_cards/apply.py and on re-record by agents/bridge/src/autoflow_day.ts; tools/recorded_cards/gate.py fails the build if any displayed recorded string reads like machine redaction.

B: Not yet, I will apply today
C: Not eligible, drop this competition

evidence: Why now: the entry only counts if you are a program member by Nov 18.
Owning a headset does not count; membership is checked on its own.

16.title: Which approach should we use to map geothermal faults?

options.label: A: An image model on the official map layers
B: A, plus fault scarps from laser elevation maps (recommended)
C: B, plus learning that treats unmarked ground as unknown

16.recommendation: B: A, plus fault scarps from laser elevation maps (recommended)
evidence: Why now: the next tasks commit GPU time and a 181 GB download to one approach.
Only newly found faults score, and a missed fault costs four times a false alarm.
B is how geologists find new faults, and the one top-five team that shared its method used it.

17.title: For the coding-agent competition, should we only improve the agent around the large model, also fine-tune it on paid compute, or add a second entry with a small model?

options.label: A: Improve the agent around the large model, no training
B: A, plus fine-tuning (needs paid compute)
C: A, plus a small-model entry for the $10k bonus (recommended)

17.recommendation: C: A, plus a small-model entry for the $10k bonus (recommended)
evidence: Why now: each task gets about five minutes on the scorer's machine, and running over scores zero.
Fixing three common agent failures could beat today's leader; fine-tuning would cost $100 to $300.
C adds a cheap second entry aimed at the $10k bonus for small models.

A is the only option with a working build, and no one has shipped agent supervision on a headset.
If unanswered: A becomes binding on Nov 5 at noon.
